name: zsnd_cd_is_stereo_aux_enabled
description: zSndCd::IsStereoAuxEnabled reports stereo AUX only when the CD subsystem is ready, an AUX device is present, and the stereo AUX flag is set.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the coherent zSndCd source-file cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a27d0 returns zero when the ready flag is clear, returns zero when the AUX device id is -1, and otherwise returns the stereo AUX flag.
Native smoke zsnd_cd_is_stereo_aux_enabled_smoke verifies not-ready, missing-AUX, and ready stereo-AUX cases.
